ways.title: Three ways, one project
ways.intro: Pick whichever suits you: you get the same ready-to-run project.
ways.cli.title: Create it in the terminal
ways.cli.body: Paste the command in a terminal: answer a few questions to pick the framework and tools, and the project is created with its packages installed.
ways.command.title: Pick here, copy the command
ways.command.body: Whatever you pick below becomes one command. Paste it in a terminal and the same project is created without any questions.
ways.site.title: Get it from the site
ways.site.body: No terminal needed: download the project as a ZIP, create it as a GitHub repository or run it in the browser right away.

wizard.title: What are you building?
wizard.intro: Answer three questions and get a stack that fits. You can change any of it afterwards.
wizard.goal.content.hint: Landing page, blog, docs: fast pages that search engines read
wizard.goal.app.hint: Dashboard, admin panel, tool: screens, state and data
wizard.goal.fullstack.hint: Sign-in, an API and a database, in one project
wizard.why.content: {framework} renders pages to HTML ahead of time: fast to load and easy for search engines.
wizard.why.app: {framework} for an app with many screens, with a UI kit, state and data fetching ready.
wizard.why.fullstack: A {framework} app with an Express or NestJS API next to it in server/, PostgreSQL and email sign-in.
live.hint: Run the project right here, in a StackBlitz WebContainer. The first start installs the packages (about half a minute); after that your picks update it as you go.
